conbody.p: A timeline needs more width than a phone has, so the phone shows the same plan as a schedule. Four tiles give the figures. Under Schedule, the tasks are grouped by the milestone they are assigned to, with the rest under Not assigned to a milestone and those with no dates folded under Not scheduled until you tap Show, each with its dates, duration and a progress bar, and Critical on a task with no float; Milestones lists the milestones with their progress. Tap a task or a milestone to open it and make the same edits as on a computer, by setting dates rather than dragging.
On a tablet the chart is shown. With a touch screen, bars do not drag and links are not drawn: set a task's dates and relationships in its panel.
